verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:

segments.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

segments.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

segments.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

verses.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love

segments.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love

verses.text: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,

segments.text: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,

verses.text: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.

segments.text: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.

verses.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace

segments.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace

verses.text: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.

segments.text: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.

verses.text: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ

segments.text: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ

verses.text: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.

segments.text: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.

verses.text: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,

segments.text: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,

verses.text: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.

segments.text: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.

verses.text: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth—the gospel of your salvation—you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

segments.text: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.

verses.text: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

segments.text: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

verses.text: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

segments.text: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

verses.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

segments.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

verses.text: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
